title: V-8 454 ENGINE H.D. RAD. SUPPORT & SEAL CUTTING
summary: CANCELED sheet. RPO LS7 454 heavy-duty V-8: radiator support assembly at the front of the engine compartment, with two .375 holes drilled through the upper support, production seal and production bracket, joined by a bolt, production lock washer, washer and nut. The RH bracket hole is elongated (View A) and the production radiator seal is cut down on the RH side only (View B).

fastening.note: Bolt [3] goes from the front/bracket side through the production bracket, the production seal and the two .375 dia. holes drilled in the support [4]; production lock washer, washer [2] and nut [1] on the other end. Holes .96 apart (typical).

notes: NOTE: Cut seal to dimensions shown R.H. side only. (View B: .62 x 4.50)
notes_internal: Item 1 pn: hole punch wipes the middle digits; visible '10' ... '4'. Gap width suggests about 4 hidden digits (estimate only).
Item 1 has a torque triangle with no number in it, and the torque legend is blank: no torque recorded.
